cmake_minimum_required (VERSION 2.6)
project (Crabs)
# Single-TU rule: one .cpp = one .exe. The entry lives in _Seams.cpp (this
# directory); the generated .cpp wrapper (build tree) is the only source.
file (MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
file (WRITE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/_Seams.cpp"
  "// Generated by CMake. Single-TU wrapper: pull in the one real source.\n"
  "#include \"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/_Seams.cpp\"\n")
add_executable(Crabs "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/_Seams.cpp")
# The repo root is needed for angle-bracket includes like <_Config.h> and
# <_Package.hxx>; _Seams/ is the directory of _Seams.cpp so its quoted
# includes ("01.Core.hxx" ...) resolve there.
target_include_directories(Crabs PRIVATE
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.."
)
set_target_properties(Crabs PROPERTIES
  CXX_STANDARD 23
  CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
  CXX_EXTENSIONS ON
)
